timeline.body:
Motivation:

We cant reuse the ChannelPromise as it will cause an error when trying to ful-fill it multiple times.

Modifications:

- Use a new promise and chain it with the old one
- Add unit test

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/10240
@normanmaurer do we risk an NPE here? https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/10248/files#diff-1eb10f9889aa482b57792f4cb001aa2dL99

reply.body: nope as `write` will set `closeSent` I think ?
